cleared_by: walk/run selector when the previous surface is not $19
marker.set_by: surface $19 handler $6B23 (floor sample, every contact pass)

shared_index.consequence: walk and run share ONE index: a $05 <-> $06 change keeps the phase (index mod 4 entering run or strip, mod 6 for ordinary walk)
shared_index.rule: INC; if >= cycle_length then 0; frame := index + base_frame

walk_selector.order: side contact ($D523 & $0C) -> frame $5E, duration 2 (before any strip test); else marker bit 0 set and previous surface ($D36C & $1F) == $19 -> strip set; else marker cleared and $D3BC zeroed; then the shared index $D52F
